Override.entitydescription.smgunique: A tactical carbine no longer in circulation on Europa’s market, delivering superior sustained firepower compared to submachine guns.
Override.entitydescription.commonerclothes1: A simple sleeveless outfit worn by outpost residents.
Override.entitydescription.commonerclothes2: Standard everyday clothing for outpost dwellers.
Override.entitydescription.medicalofficeroutfit: Worn by medical staff stationed at outposts. The bulky overcoat offers ample storage for small items, yet significantly slows down swimming speed.
Override.entitydescription.doctorsuniform1: Designed for frontline medical personnel. Reinforced armor grants moderate physical protection, while limiting the quantity of portable medical supplies.
Override.entitydescription.doctorsuniform2: Standard attire for shipboard doctors. Form-fitted for easy swimming and diving suit donning. Sealed glove compartments allow storage of emergency medications.
Override.entitydescription.stationadminoutfit: Official uniform of outpost supervisors. Merchants offer substantial buy and sell discounts when this attire is worn, recognizing the wearer as station leadership. Also increases mission reward payouts.
Override.entitydescription.mineroutfit: Loose vests commonly worn by miners in sweltering mine tunnels. The relaxed fit boosts movement speed at the cost of increased vulnerability to burn damage.
Override.entitydescription.quartermasteroutfit: The quartermaster’s standard uniform. It imparts no specialized knowledge, but provides extra carrying capacity for handheld tools.
Override.entitydescription.securityuniform3: A standard issue gunner uniform fitted with exoskeleton assist components and a utility backpack. Overall mobility of the wearer is reduced as a trade-off.
Override.entitydescription.securityuniform1: Dark "intra-vessel camouflage", providing limited resistance against gunshot and piercing damage.
Override.entitydescription.securityuniform2: Preferred attire for onboard security officers. Tailored to contain vessel-wide violent incidents, offering balanced defense against multiple damage types.
